description: Architecture Regression Gauntlet: a single command that re-verifies the new config/path/CLI/reproducibility/evidence/frontend/storage spine works together AND that all legacy script entry points still work. Read-only against the live repo; T:/ not required; fail-closed safety defaults verified under a clean env.
purpose: Catch any regression in the 6-rung architecture sprint with one invocation: `python scripts/dev/architecture_regression_gauntlet.py --strict`. Runs in CI alongside the other quality gates.
invariants: Every CLI subcommand (--version, config show, config doctor, doctor, status --summary, evidence validate) exits 0 or 1 and produces a recognizable status report.
Legacy scripts (determinex_doctor.py, determinex_status.py --summary, evidence_index.py --check) remain runnable with no breakage.
All read-only inspection commands preserve the SHA-256 of assurance/evidence/evidence_index.json and every locks/sentinel/*.json file.
determinex_settings resolves every path-with-fallback to a working value under a CLEAN environment (no DETERMINEX_*, no HF_HOME, no OLLAMA_*).
Every DETERMINEX_* env override is honored, and the override path appears in the resolved property — no T:/ drive letter required for correctness.

Under a clean env, all safety flags fail closed: online_discovery=False, allow_cloud_fallback=False, allow_unsandboxed=False, require_docker=True, require_cloak=True, offline_observer=True, flywheel_auto=False.
The status-token set is frozen — pinned both in the gauntlet module and in this lock manifest. Drift fails test_lock_manifest_status_tokens_match_module.
The just runner is OPTIONAL — when absent, the four just.* recipe checks return JUST_RUNNER_MISSING_SKIPPED rather than failing the rollup.
Evidence-index validation uses the --check flag (read-only); the gauntlet never writes evidence_index.json.
The gauntlet itself does not mutate the live repo — it shells out to subprocesses and hashes a watched file set before+after.
test_coverage: status tokens are a frozen closed set (matches expected enumeration)
REPO_ROOT and SCRIPTS_DIR resolve to the live repo
check_just_runner returns a known token (graceful skip when just missing)
read-only guard returns PRESERVED on clean run (no mutation)
path portability confirmed under clean env + temp override
unsafe defaults blocked under clean env (all 8 flags match expectations)
_hash_tree detects single-byte mutation across a directory
full gauntlet rolls up to PASSED on live repo (marked slow)
lock manifest exists; status tokens align with module; checks_run pinned
ci_recommendation: Add a `arch-gauntlet` job to .github/workflows/test.yml that runs `python scripts/dev/architecture_regression_gauntlet.py --strict`. Currently NOT wired (kept as a developer-side check until the gauntlet's stability has been observed across multiple commits).
